note: False-positive rate on tiles whose labels are empty, i.e. real side-scan seabed verified to contain no object. This is how the artificial-vs-natural requirement is scored: there is no natural class, because nobody draws boxes around rocks.
scale_warning: `threshold` is a RAW detector score. The shipped review floor is applied to CALIBRATED confidence, and the two differ sharply -- the 0.20 floor corresponds to a raw score near 0.02. Read the rate at the operating point from ai/scripts/derive_review_floor.py, which sweeps calibrated confidence; quoting a row from here as the deployed false-alarm rate overstates the model.
